# appsignal_uptime_monitor (Resource)

An uptime monitor in an AppSignal app. AppSignal checks the URL every minute and expects a 2xx response within 30 seconds; neither can be configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appsignal_notifier" "email" {
  app_id = appsignal_app.web.id
  name   = "Default email notifier"
}

resource "appsignal_uptime_monitor" "homepage" {
  app_id                 = appsignal_app.web.id
  name                   = "www.example.com"
  url                    = "https://www.example.com/health"
  regions                = ["europe", "north_america"]
  notifier_ids           = [data.appsignal_notifier.email.id]
  warmup_duration        = 3
  check_body_content     = "ok"
  monitor_ssl_expiration = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `regions` (Set of String) Regions to check from: europe, north_america, asia_pacific, south_america.
- `url` (String)

### Optional

- `check_body_content` (String) Text the response body must contain.
- `description` (String)
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers sent with every check.
- `monitor_ssl_expiration` (Boolean) Alert before the certificate expires. Defaults to false.
- `notifier_ids` (Set of String) Notifiers alerted when the monitor fails. See the appsignal_notifier data source.
- `warmup_duration` (Number) Minutes the check must keep failing before an alert opens. Defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_uptime_monitor.homepage <app_id>/<uptime_monitor_id>
```
